scenes.text: Think of your skin's surface as a brick wall. When the mortar runs low, water escapes through the gaps.
scenes.head:
Step 1
Gaps let water out

scenes.text: Ceramides are a big part of that mortar. They fill the gaps between your skin cells.
scenes.head:
Step 2
Ceramides fill the gaps

scenes.text: Water stays in, so your skin feels softer and less tight.
scenes.head:

scenes.text: On the label, look for ceramide N P. Next episode: panthenol.

caption:
What ceramides actually do for your skin barrier 🧱
Your skin's surface works like a brick wall. Ceramides are a big part of the mortar: they fill the gaps between cells so water stays in and skin feels less tight.
On the label: ceramide NP, ceramide AP, ceramide EOP.
Save this for your next routine. Ingredient Explained, ep. 04.
Kobi launches 25 Nov. Waitlist in bio.
